criteria.border_white_frac: fraction of pixels in the outer 8 px ring whose minimum channel is >= 235 (the assembler's near-white threshold)
criteria.silhouette: pixels that are not near-white AND differ from the border's median colour by > 40 on some channel, opened twice (3x3)
criteria.components_ge_1pct: 8-connected components of the silhouette with area >= 1 % of the largest (a single figure = 1)
criteria.lowest_row_frac / top_row_frac: extent of those components over the image height; < 0.995 and > 0.01 mean the feet and the head are inside the frame
criteria.bbox_h_over_w: height / width of the largest component's bounding box
criteria.dark_clusters_outside_figure: 8-connected components of pixels with min channel < 90, area 20-3000 px, centred outside the main bbox (+-10 px): a proxy for text, watermarks and stray marks
criteria.pass_rule: border_white_frac >= 0.99 and components_ge_1pct == 1 and lowest_row_frac < 0.995 and top_row_frac > 0.01 and bbox_h_over_w >= 3 and dark_clusters_outside_figure == 0
criteria.bbox_rule_dropped: the bbox_h_over_w >= 3 rule was tuned on one slim silhouette (sample) and is not a property of a good standing figure: ball-gown skirts, twin tails and wide sleeves are wide by design, so it was dropped for this set; PASS_without_h_over_w is the rule without it

criteria_as_recorded: PASS = border_white_frac>=0.99 (outer 8 px, min channel>=235) and components_ge_1pct==1 and lowest_row_frac<0.995 and top_row_frac>0.01 and bbox_h_over_w>=3 and dark_clusters_outside_figure==0; silhouette = not near-white and >40 from border median colour, opened x2
